plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: if [ -n "$RELEASE_VERSION" ] && [ "$RELEASE_VERSION" != "${nextRelease.version}" ]; then echo "build zipped $RELEASE_VERSION, but the release is ${nextRelease.version}" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo ${nextRelease.version} > .release-version
plugins.prepareCmd: npm pkg set version=${nextRelease.version} --prefix apps/extension && if [ "${branch.type}" = prerelease ]; then git checkout HEAD -- apps/extension/package.json CHANGELOG.md; fi
